descriptions.zh:
本接口目前支持的地域为华北2（北京）、华东2（上海）、华东1（杭州），其他地域暂不支持。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
This API is available in the China North 2 (Beijing), China East 2 (Shanghai), and China East 1 (Hangzhou) regions. It is not available in other regions.

## QPS limits

You can make up to 50 queries per second (QPS) to this API. If you exceed the limit, rate limiting is applied to your API calls, which may affect your services. Make API calls only as needed. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
